_result_entry_schema.function_slot: string - one of: main, i2c_write, i2c_read, uart_read, uart_write
_result_entry_schema.input: value or object sent to the DUT for this test
_result_entry_schema.expected_output: value pulled from expectations.json at run time
_result_entry_schema.actual_output: value returned by the DUT over UART
_result_entry_schema.latency_ms: float - time between command sent and result received
_result_entry_schema.fault_injected: bool - whether the Pico was told to misbehave for this test
